How to Download the E-Call Letter for RRB Guwahati DV

Shortlisted candidates cannot walk into the DV without a valid e-call letter. This section explains when and where the e-call letter becomes available and what to do with it.

  • The e-call letter download link goes live on the official RRB Guwahati website (rrbguwahati.gov.in) 4 days before each candidate's scheduled DV date.
  • Candidates must download, print, and carefully read all instructions mentioned in the e-call letter.
  • SMS and email alerts are sent to the registered mobile number and email ID once the e-call letter is available for download.
  • Eligible SC/ST candidates will be provided free travel authority as per existing rules.

Mandatory Portal Upload: Signature, Photo & Identification Marks

Before appearing for DV, candidates must complete an online formality that many overlook. Here's what needs to be uploaded and where.

  • Detailed upload instructions are available directly on the portal.
  • The portal remains active until the date of Document Verification.
  • Candidates should refer to the detailed instructions in their DV e-call letter for guidance.

Documents Required for RRB Section Controller DV

Carrying the correct documents is critical, as incomplete documentation can lead to rejection at the DV stage. This section lists what candidates must bring.

Candidates called for Document Verification must carry:

  1. All original documents/certificates, as specified in the CEN and the e-call letter.
  2. Two sets of photocopies of all documents, in A4 size.
  3. No Objection Certificate (NOC) applicable only to candidates currently serving in any Central/State Government department (including Railways or PSUs), including those undergoing induction training or probation. Without an NOC on the DV date, candidature will be cancelled.

RRB Guwahati Medical Examination: Date, Fee & Process

Medical fitness is a mandatory part of the selection process for Section Controller posts. This section explains when and where the medical exam takes place and what it costs candidates.

  • The medical examination is conducted on 16 July 2026, the day immediately after Document Verification.
  • It takes place at a nominated Railway Hospital under the jurisdiction of the Northeast Frontier Railway (NFR).
  • Candidates should be prepared to stay for 3 to 4 days to complete the medical process.
  • The prescribed medical fee is only ₹24, with no additional charges payable to the hospital/health unit.
  • In select cases requiring tests like CT scan, ultrasound, or refractive eye surgery screening where such facilities aren't available at the Railway Hospital candidates may need to pay the concerned lab/hospital directly.

Block Date for Absentee Candidates: Last Chance to Attend DV

Missing the scheduled DV date doesn't always mean automatic rejection. This section explains the block date provision and who is eligible for it.

  • The block date is 27 July 2026, 9:30 A.M., at RRB Guwahati.
  • This is the second and final opportunity for candidates who could not report on their originally scheduled DV date.
  • Failure to report on the assigned date is treated as rejection of candidature, unless supported by documentary evidence that the candidate:
    • Had to appear in a University/Government examination, or
    • Was unwell (sickness).
  • No other reason for absence will be considered.
  • No fresh e-call letter is issued for the block date candidates must attend using the same e-call letter downloaded for their regular DV.

Important Instructions for Shortlisted Candidates

Beyond dates and documents, RRB Guwahati has issued several general instructions that shortlisted candidates should keep in mind throughout the process.

  • Read the CEN carefully: Candidates should thoroughly review all instructions in the detailed Centralized Employment Notification (CEN) and its corrigendum, and retain a record of information filled in their application form.
  • Candidature is provisional: Shortlisting for DV/medical examination does not guarantee appointment. Candidature can be cancelled at any stage if discrepancies or malpractice are found.
  • No entitlement to job: Being called for DV or medical examination does not entitle a candidate to a Railway appointment.
  • RRB reserves correction rights: RRB may rectify inadvertent errors or typographical/printing mistakes in the result, and will not entertain correspondence on this matter.
  • Beware of touts: RRB's recruitment process is fully computerized, and selection is based purely on merit. Candidates should be cautious of anyone promising selection through illegal means.

What Is the RRB Group D Cut Off?

Before checking the numbers, it helps to understand what this cut off actually represents and why it differs across regions and categories.

The RRB Group D Cut Off is the minimum score a candidate must secure in the Computer Based Test (CBT) to qualify for the next stage of selection the Physical Efficiency Test (PET). It is not a fixed number; it is decided by each Railway Recruitment Board zone based on the number of vacancies in that zone, the difficulty level of the exam, and how candidates performed overall. Because RRB conducts the exam across multiple shifts and days, scores are normalized before the final cut off is calculated, ensuring fairness across different sets of question papers.

Factors Affecting RRB Group D Cut Off 2026

Cut off marks change every recruitment cycle. This section explains the main reasons why the 2026 cut off differs from previous years and across zones.

  • Number of vacancies: More vacancies in a zone generally lead to a lower cut off, while fewer vacancies push competition and the cut off higher.
  • Number of candidates appearing: Zones with a larger applicant pool tend to see a tougher, higher cut off.
  • Difficulty level of the exam: Easier shifts result in higher scores overall, which raises the cut off; tougher shifts have the opposite effect.
  • Zone-wise competition: Cut off marks vary from zone to zone since each RRB region has its own applicant base and vacancy count.
  • Category-wise reservation: Separate cut offs are released for UR, EWS, OBC, SC, and ST as per the reservation policy.
  • Score normalization: Since the CBT runs across multiple shifts and days, RRB normalizes scores to keep the process fair before deciding the final cut off.
  • Previous year's trends: Historical cut off data gives a reference point, though the final number always depends on the current cycle's specific vacancy and performance data.

How to Check RRB Group D Cut Off 2026

Follow these steps to view and download your zone's official cut off marks.

  1. Visit the official website of your respective RRB zone (for example, rrbcdg.gov.in) or the unified portal rrb.indianrailways.gov.in.
  2. Look for the "RRB Group D CEN 08/2024 Result/Cut Off" notification link.
  3. Click to open the cut off PDF.
  4. Check the category-wise and zone-wise marks listed in the PDF.
  5. Download or save the PDF for future reference.

What's Next After the RRB Group D 2026 Cut Off?

Clearing the cut off is not the final step in selection. This section explains what happens after the CBT result and cut off are declared.

Candidates who score equal to or above the official cut off are shortlisted for the following stages:

  1. Physical Efficiency Test (PET) - A qualifying-only stage; marks scored here are not added to the final merit list.
  2. Document Verification (DV) - Verification of educational, category, and identity documents.
  3. Medical Examination - A fitness test as per the medical standards applicable to the specific post.
  4. Final Merit List - Prepared after successful completion of all the above stages.

RRB Group D Cut Off: 2022 vs 2018 Trends

Comparing past cycles helps candidates gauge how competitive the exam typically is, though each cycle's cut off depends on that year's specific vacancies and applicant numbers.

In the 2022 cycle, the CBT was conducted from 17 August to 11 October 2022, and cut off marks varied significantly by zone for instance, the UR normalised cut off ranged from around 60 to 70 marks depending on the region. In the 2018 cycle, cut off marks (on the older marking pattern) ranged roughly between 62 and 80 for the UR category across zones. Both cycles confirm that cut off marks fluctuate zone-to-zone based on vacancy count and competition level, a pattern that continues in 2026.

The Final Answer Key is the confirmed, expert-reviewed set of correct answers released by GSSSB after examining any objections raised against the Provisional Answer Key. It is used as the official reference for evaluating candidates' answer sheets and preparing the result or merit list.

Exam Pattern for GSSSB Wireman and Chemical Assistant 2026

This section explains the structure of the CBRT exam conducted for both posts, including the number of questions and sections.

Both the Wireman and Chemical Assistant recruitment exams followed an identical exam pattern. The CBRT exam was divided into two parts:

  • Part A: 90 questions
  • Part B: 120 questions
  • Total Questions: 210 questions

GSSSB Final Answer Key 2026 Marking Scheme

This section details the marking scheme applicable to both the Wireman and Chemical Assistant final answer keys.

GSSSB has confirmed the following marking scheme for evaluating candidate responses in both exams:

Section Total Questions Total Marks Marks for Correct Answer Negative Marking
Part A 90 90 +1.0 -0.25
Part B 120 120 +1.0 -0.25

This means every correct answer will be awarded 1 mark, while 0.25 marks will be deducted for every incorrect answer in both Part A and Part B.

Were Any Changes Made to the Provisional Answer Key?

This section clarifies whether GSSSB made any revisions to the answers between the provisional and final answer key stage.

According to the official notice, no online objections were submitted by candidates against the Provisional Answer Key for either the Wireman or Chemical Assistant exam. However, GSSSB got all 210 questions from both Part A and Part B re-verified by subject matter experts as a standard due-diligence process. Following this expert review, GSSSB confirmed that no corrections or changes were required to any answer in Part A or Part B for either exam. As a result, the Final Answer Key remains the same as the Provisional Answer Key for both posts.

OSSSC CRE Prelims Marking Scheme 2026

Before calculating a probable score from the answer key, it helps to know exactly how marks are awarded and deducted in the OSSSC CRE Prelims exam.

  • Each correct answer carries 1 mark.
  • Each incorrect answer attracts a negative marking of 0.25 mark.
  • No marks are deducted for questions left unattempted.

Formula to calculate score:

Score = (Number of Correct Answers × 1) − (Number of Incorrect Answers × 0.25)

Steps to Calculate Your Probable Score

  1. Download the OSSSC RI ARI Answer Key 2026 PDF.
  2. Compare each of your marked responses with the official key.
  3. Count the total correct answers and multiply by 1.
  4. Count the total incorrect answers and multiply by 0.25.
  5. Subtract the negative marks from the total correct marks to get your probable score.

Background of the RPSC SSO (Home Dept.) 2024 Exam

RPSC had invited online applications for Senior Scientific Officer posts under the Home Department from 19 December 2024 to 17 January 2025. The written examination was conducted from 12 to 16 May 2025 across multiple divisions of the State Forensic Science Laboratory, Jaipur, including Biology, Documents, Serology, Cyber Forensic, Narcotics, and Physics.

A provisional (model) answer key was released in early June 2025, with an objection window open for candidates to challenge specific answers on payment of a fee per question. RPSC has been releasing the final, division-wise answer keys in stages; the Cyber Forensic, Narcotics, Physics, and Serology keys were confirmed on 3 July 2026.

Aspect Provisional Answer Key Final Answer Key
Purpose Allows candidates to raise objections Used to calculate official scores
Objections Accepted within a fixed window, with a fee per question Not accepted the key is conclusive
Changes May be revised based on valid objections Reflects all approved corrections and deletions

Once the final answer key for a division is published, RPSC evaluates candidates' OMR sheets against it to compute marks. This is typically followed by:

  • Release of a provisional consideration or shortlist for document verification

For reference, RPSC has already completed this cycle for the Biology Division of the same SSO (Home Dept.) 2024 exam, where cut-off marks and the final main/reserve list were declared in late June 2026 after document verification. UP Lekhpal Revised Answer Key 2026 - Direct PDF Download Link, Cut Off & Result Date

The UP Lekhpal Revised Answer Key 2026 is officially out. The Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) released the revised (final) answer key for the Revenue Lekhpal Mains Examination on its official website, upsssc.gov.in, on 1 July 2026. This revised key comes after the commission examined all objections raised by candidates against the earlier provisional answer key, making it the basis on which the final result and merit list will be prepared. Candidates who appeared for the UP Lekhpal Mains Exam on 21 May 2026 can now download the set-wise PDF, match their responses, and calculate their expected score using the official marking scheme.

Add FJA on  As Preferred Source

This article covers everything you need to know about the UP Lekhpal Revised Answer Key 2026 the download link, how to check it, the objection process that led to this revision, qualifying marks, expected cut off, and the likely result date.

Click Here: UP Lekhpal Revised Answer Key 2026

What Is the UP Lekhpal Revised Answer Key 2026?

This section explains what the revised answer key is and why it matters more than the earlier provisional key.

The UP Lekhpal Revised Answer Key 2026 is the updated and near-final set of correct answers released by UPSSSC after reviewing the objections that candidates filed against the provisional answer key. Whenever the commission accepts an objection because a question was found to be wrong, ambiguous, or had more than one correct option the answer for that question is corrected in this revised key. Since it reflects all approved corrections, the revised answer key is considered significantly more reliable than the provisional one for estimating your final score, and it will be the key used to prepare the official UP Lekhpal Result 2026.

UP Lekhpal Revised Answer Key 2026 - Key Highlights

This table summarizes the most important dates and details related to the UP Lekhpal Mains Exam and its answer key, giving you a quick snapshot before you go through the full details below.

How to Download the UP Lekhpal Revised Answer Key 2026 PDF

This section explains the step-by-step process to download the revised answer key from the official UPSSSC website.

Candidates who took the Lekhpal Mains exam can download the revised answer key directly from the UPSSSC portal. Since the answer key is released set-wise (Set A, B, C, D), make sure you select the same paper series that you received in your exam hall before matching your answers.

  1. Visit the official UPSSSC website at upsssc.gov.in.
  2. Go to the "Latest News" or "Answer Key" section on the homepage.
  3. Click on the link that reads "UP Lekhpal Mains Revised Answer Key 2026."
  4. Select your Question Paper Set/Series (A, B, C, or D).
  5. The answer key PDF will open on your screen download and save it.
  6. Compare each answer with the responses you marked in your exam to estimate your expected score.

Candidates are advised to download the PDF only from the official website and keep a saved copy for future reference, since this revised key will be used to determine the final result.

Why Was the Answer Key Revised? Understanding the Objection Process

This section explains why UPSSSC issued a revised key instead of directly declaring results after the provisional key, and what the objection process involved.

After the provisional answer key was released on 22 May 2026, UPSSSC gave candidates a fixed window to challenge any answer they believed was incorrect. This objection facility was active from 26 May 2026 to 1 June 2026. The process worked as follows:

  • Candidates had to log in on the official portal using their registration number and password.
  • They could select the specific question(s) they wanted to challenge and upload supporting proof or reference material for the claimed correct answer.
  • A nominal fee (approximately ₹100 per question) had to be paid online for each objection raised, ensuring only genuine, well-supported challenges were submitted.
  • Only objections submitted with valid proof within the deadline and with successful fee payment were considered valid.

Once the objection window closed, UPSSSC's subject-matter experts reviewed every valid objection. Wherever a challenge was found genuine, the answer was updated and the outcome of this entire exercise is the Revised Answer Key 2026 released on 1 July 2026.

UP Lekhpal Exam 2026: Important Details

This section recaps the exam details that are directly relevant to understanding and using the answer key correctly.

The UP Lekhpal Mains Written Examination was conducted by UPSSSC on 21 May 2026 in a single shift from 10:00 AM to 12:00 Noon across multiple exam centres in Uttar Pradesh. The recruitment drive aims to fill 7,994 Revenue Lekhpal posts. The provisional answer key was released the very next day, on 22 May 2026, followed by the objection window, and finally the revised answer key on 1 July 2026.

How to Calculate Your Score Using the Revised Answer Key

This section explains the exact marking scheme so candidates can calculate their tentative score accurately.

Once you have matched your responses against the revised answer key, you can calculate your probable score using the official UPSSSC marking scheme:

  • Correct Answer: +1 mark
  • Incorrect Answer: −0.25 mark (negative marking of one-fourth mark per wrong answer)
  • Unattempted Question: No mark deducted

Formula to calculate your score:

Final Score = (Total Correct Answers × 1) − (Total Wrong Answers × 0.25)

This section lists the minimum percentage of marks each category must secure to be considered for the final merit list, regardless of overall cut-off trends.

Category Minimum Qualifying Marks

SC / ST 40%

Candidates scoring below their category's minimum qualifying percentage will not be considered for the final merit list, even if their raw score is close to the expected cut off.

UP Lekhpal Expected Cut Off 2026

This section explains the factors that will influence the final cut off and gives an approximate expected range based on exam difficulty and past trends.

The final UP Lekhpal cut off depends on multiple factors: the overall difficulty level of the paper, the total number of candidates who appeared, the number of vacancies (7,994 posts), and category-wise reservation norms. Since the paper has been assessed as easy-to-moderate in difficulty, a slightly higher cut off compared to previous years is expected. Based on these trends, the approximate safe/expected scores are:

Category Expected Safe Score (out of 100)
General 74 - 80
EWS 72 - 77
OBC 70 - 76
SC 60 - 67
ST 57 - 64

Note: These figures are indicative estimates based on exam difficulty and historical trends. The official cut off will be declared by UPSSSC only along with the final result.

The Gujarat Public Service Commission (GPSC) has officially released the Provisional Answer Key 2025-26 for multiple recruitment examinations, including posts of Assistant Professor and Child Development Project Officer (CDPO). Candidates who appeared for these preliminary examinations can now download the answer key PDFs - identified as PAK-94, PAK-91, PAK-85, PAK-83, and PAK-26 - directly from the official GPSC website at gpsc.gujarat.gov.in. This article consolidates everything you need: direct download links, the objection submission process, fee details, important dates, and answers to the most common questions asked by candidates.

Add FJA on  As Preferred Source

What Is the GPSC Provisional Answer Key 2025-26?

This section explains what the provisional answer key is and why it matters for every candidate who appeared in the GPSC 2025-26 examinations.

The GPSC Provisional Answer Key is the official document published by the Gujarat Public Service Commission immediately after a preliminary examination. It lists the correct answer (A, B, C, or D) for every question in the Master Question Paper. The "provisional" nature of the key means it is open for review - candidates who believe any answer is incorrect can formally challenge it within a fixed window. After evaluating all valid objections, GPSC releases a Final Answer Key, which forms the definitive basis for calculating scores and determining merit lists.

The answer keys released under the advertisement numbers below belong to the 2025-26 recruitment cycle and cover subject-specific preliminary examinations under Gujarat Education Service (GES), Class-2 and Women & Child Development Department posts.

GPSC Provisional Answer Key 2025-26: Quick Overview

The table below provides a consolidated snapshot of all five answer keys released, covering the advertisement numbers, PAK codes, and links for download.

PAK Code Post Download Link
PAK-94-2025-26 Assistant Professor (GES, Class-2) Download PDF
PAK-91-2025-26 Assistant Professor (GES, Class-2) Download PDF
PAK-85-2025-26 Assistant Professor (GES, Class-2) Download PDF
PAK-83-2025-26 Assistant Professor (GES, Class-2) Download PDF
PAK-26-2025-26 Child Development Project Officer (CDPO), Class-2 Download PDF

Note: Always verify subject-specific details and exact examination dates on the official GPSC portal at gpsc.gujarat.gov.in, as GPSC may update information after this publication.

How to Download the GPSC Provisional Answer Key 2025-26 PDF

This section gives you a simple, step-by-step guide to downloading the official provisional answer key from the GPSC website without confusion or delay.

  1. Open your browser and visit the official GPSC website: gpsc.gujarat.gov.in
  2. On the homepage, look for the "Latest News / Events" section or navigate to the "Answer Key" tab.
  3. Find the link corresponding to your advertisement number (e.g., PAK-94-2025-26, PAK-91-2025-26, etc.).
  4. Click the link; the PDF will either open in your browser or begin downloading automatically.
  5. Save the Master Question Paper alongside the answer key for accurate cross-referencing.
  6. Match each question number from the Master Question Paper to the provisional answer provided. Do not use the question numbering from your own booklet set, as sets may differ.

You can also use the direct PDF links provided in the table above to go straight to the relevant document.

Objection Fee

Candidates must pay a non-refundable fee of Rs. 100 per objection. The payment must be made online through the official link provided on the GPSC portal. An objection is considered final only after the fee receipt is generated successfully.

Step-by-Step Objection Process

  1. Visit the official GPSC Online Objection Submission portal link (available on the GPSC website after the objection window opens).
  2. Log in using your credentials (Confirmation Number and Date of Birth).
  3. Identify the Question Number and the option you wish to challenge, always referencing the Master Question Paper, not your own booklet numbering.
  4. Upload supporting documentary evidence (a textbook page, journal article, or other authentic reference). Objections submitted without evidence will be rejected outright.
  5. Ensure the answer you are suggesting matches the response you actually marked on your answer sheet. Mismatched responses are automatically rejected.
  6. Pay the Rs. 100 fee online and save the payment receipt.
  7. Submit the objection before the deadline. Late submissions are not entertained under any circumstances.

Critical Rules to Remember Before Submitting Objections

  • No AI-generated objections: GPSC has explicitly stated that objections backed solely by AI tools (such as ChatGPT or similar) without documentary evidence from a recognized source will not be considered.
  • Calculation-based questions: For mathematical or reasoning questions, the objection must include the full working, methodology, or logical basis.
  • Question numbering must match the Master Paper: Quoting a different question number (from your booklet set) than the one appearing in the Master Question Paper will result in rejection.
  • One fee = one objection: Each challenged question requires a separate payment of Rs. 100.
  • Fees are non-refundable: Even if your objection is accepted and the answer is revised, the fee is not returned.

What Happens After the Provisional Answer Key?

Many candidates wonder what the timeline looks like after the provisional answer key is out. This section outlines the standard GPSC process that follows the provisional key release.

  • Objection Window Opens: Candidates can submit challenges through the online objection portal for a fixed period (typically a few days after the key release).
  • Expert Review: GPSC's subject experts evaluate all valid, evidence-backed objections.
  • Final Answer Key Released: After incorporating any corrections, GPSC publishes the Final (Official) Answer Key, which is absolute and binding for result calculation.
  • Preliminary Result Declared: Based on the Final Answer Key, GPSC publishes the list of candidates qualifying for the Main Written Examination.
  • Main Examination: Shortlisted candidates appear for the subject-specific Main Exam, which carries actual merit weightage.
  • Final Selection: The overall merit list is prepared based on Main Exam performance (and interview, if applicable), leading to the final appointment recommendation.

Candidates are advised to regularly check gpsc.gujarat.gov.in for official updates on result dates and subsequent stages of the recruitment process.

Important Tips for Candidates: Maximizing Your Score Estimate

While waiting for the final answer key and result, candidates can take these steps to accurately estimate their performance and plan their next move.

  • Download both the Master Question Paper and the Provisional Answer Key PDF together - matching answers using only the Master Paper's question numbers avoids errors caused by different booklet sets.
  • Calculate your attempted score carefully. GPSC preliminary exams typically follow a specific marking scheme - confirm the marks per question and negative marking (if any) from the official notification for your advertisement number.
  • If you identify a genuinely incorrect answer and have strong documentary proof, submit an objection without hesitation. A single corrected answer can shift your score above the cutoff.
  • Avoid circulating or relying on unofficial answer keys shared on social media or Telegram channels, as these may be inaccurate. Always refer to the official GPSC provisional answer key PDF.
  • Begin Main Examination preparation in parallel, especially for subject-specific papers, as the gap between the preliminary result and main exam can be short.

What is the UP Home Guard Final Answer Key 2026?

The final answer key is the official, verified set of correct answers for the UP Home Guard written examination, published by after carefully reviewing all candidate objections raised against the provisional key. Understanding the difference between a provisional and a final answer key is important for every aspirant.

After the provisional answer key was released on 7 May 2026, candidates were given a window from 7 May to 10 May 2026 (midnight) to submit evidence-based objections against any answers they believed were incorrect. The board's subject experts then evaluated all objections received. As per the official notification, objections related to two questions were found to be valid across all six examination shifts. The final answer key incorporates these corrections, and the UP Home Guard Result 2026 has been computed based on this verified final key. No further objections or challenges are entertained after the release of the final answer key.

How to Download UP Home Guard Final Answer Key 2026 - Step-by-Step

Downloading the final answer key is a straightforward process. Follow these steps carefully to access your answer key and score card from the official portal without any confusion.

  1. Visit the Official Portal: Go to uppbpb.gov.in or the official website at uppbpb.gov.in.
  2. Click the Answer Key / Result Link: On the homepage, look for the notification titled "UP Home Guard Final Answer Key 2026" or "Home Guard Written Exam Result 2026."
  3. Enter Login Credentials: Input your Roll Number or Registration Number along with your Date of Birth (DD/MM/YYYY) and your Question Booklet Number where required.
  4. Click Submit: Press the Submit button to proceed to your personal result and answer key page.
  5. View Your Answer Key and Score: Your set-wise final answer key (Set A, B, C, or D) along with your score card will be displayed on the screen.
  6. Download and Save: Download the PDF and take a printout for future reference, especially for the upcoming Physical Standard Test (PST) and Document Verification stages.

 

Once you log in and download your scorecard, make sure to verify the following details carefully. Any discrepancy should be reported to immediately through official channels.

  • Candidate's Full Name

UP Home Guard Cut-Off Marks 2026 - Category-Wise

The cut-off marks for the UP Home Guard Written Exam 2026 have been released district-wise and category-wise along with the result on 28 June 2026. Here are some important benchmarks every candidate should be aware of.

  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: Every candidate must secure at least 25% marks (25 out of 100) in the written examination to remain in contention. Candidates scoring below 25% are automatically disqualified from the recruitment process, regardless of category.
  • Safe Score (General/OBC): According to experts, a score of 72 marks or above is considered a safe score for General and OBC category candidates.
  • PET Preparation Range: Candidates who have correctly answered approximately 70 to 75 questions are advised to immediately begin preparation for the Physical Efficiency Test (PET/PST).
  • No Negative Marking: There is no negative marking in the UP Home Guard written examination. Every correct answer carries equal marks.

Note: Exact district-wise and category-wise cut-off marks are available on the official website. Candidates are advised to check the official portal for their specific district's cut-off figures.

Validity of the Final Answer Key - What Changed from Provisional to Final

The transition from a provisional to a final answer key is a standard and transparent process that ensures fairness to all candidates. Here is what happened between the provisional and final answer key stages for the UP Home Guard 2026 recruitment.

  • The provisional answer key was released on 7 May 2026.
  • Candidates were allowed to submit evidence-based objections from 7 May to 10 May 2026 (midnight).
  • Subject experts reviewed all submitted objections thoroughly.
  • Objections about two questions were found to be valid across all six examination shifts and were corrected in the final answer key.
  • The corrected final answer key formed the basis for result computation and merit list preparation.
  • No further challenges or objections are accepted after the release of the final answer key.

What Happens Next After the UP Home Guard Final Answer Key 2026?

Clearing the written examination is the first major step in the Home Guard selection process. Candidates who have qualified in the written test and appear on the merit list must prepare for the subsequent stages of the recruitment process.

Next Stages in UP Home Guard Recruitment 2026

  1. Document Verification (DV): Shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification. All original certificates, identity proofs, educational documents, and category certificates must be produced at this stage. Any mismatch or missing documents can lead to disqualification.
  2. Physical Standard Test (PST): Candidates must meet the prescribed physical standards regarding height, weight, and chest measurements as per norms.
  3. Physical Efficiency Test (PET): This test evaluates candidates on running, and other physical fitness parameters. Only those who pass the PST proceed to PET.
  4. Final Merit List: The final selection and merit list for all 41,424 Home Guard (Swayamsevak) posts will be prepared based on performance across all stages. The written examination marks form the primary basis for the final merit list.

What Is the RPSC Analyst-cum-Programmer Final Answer Key?

The Final Answer Key is the definitive, officially approved set of correct answers for the RPSC Analyst-cum-Programmer/Deputy Director examination. It is published after the provisional answer key challenge window closes and all valid objections raised by candidates have been carefully reviewed by subject matter experts appointed by RPSC.

The final answer key carries absolute authority it is the version used to calculate the official marks of each candidate. Unlike the provisional answer key, no further objections can be raised against the final answer key. If any question was found to be incorrect, ambiguous, or contested through valid objections, RPSC may either revise the answer, award marks to all candidates who appeared for that question, or delete it entirely and all such changes will be reflected in the final answer key.

RPSC Analyst-cum-Programmer Exam Paper Structure

This section explains the two-paper pattern of the Analyst-cum-Programmer/Deputy Director written examination to help candidates understand the scope of each answer key PDF.

The RPSC Analyst-cum-Programmer examination consists of two papers, each carrying 100 marks and a duration of 2 hours. Together, both papers carry a combined total of 200 marks. Below is a summary of the subject coverage for each paper:

Paper Subject Areas Covered Total Marks Duration
Paper I Reasoning, Numerical Analysis, General Knowledge, Current Affairs 100 Marks 2 Hours
Paper II System Analysis & Design, Software Engineering, Software Project Management, Databases, Computer Networks 100 Marks 2 Hours

The minimum qualifying mark for the written examination is 40% in aggregate for General category candidates, and 36% for candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes. RPSC may additionally award up to 3 grace marks as per commission rules.

How to Download RPSC Final Answer Key 2026 for Analyst-cum-Programmer

Candidates can easily download both Paper I and Paper II final answer key PDFs from the RPSC official website by following the step-by-step process outlined below.

Step 1: Visit the official website of Rajasthan Public Service Commission at rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in.

Step 2: On the homepage, navigate to the "Answer Keys" section, which is available in the main menu or under the Quick Links area.

Step 3: On the Answer Keys page, look for the listing for "Analyst-cum-Programmer (Deputy Director) - 2024."

Step 4: You will find separate download links for Paper I Answer Key and Paper II Answer Key.

Step 5: Click on the relevant link to open the answer key PDF in your browser.

Step 6: Download and save the PDF on your device.

Step 7: Cross-check your responses against the final answer key to estimate your marks in the examination.

Difference Between Provisional and Final Answer Key

Understanding the distinction between the provisional and final answer key helps candidates interpret the significance of this release.

RPSC follows a two-stage answer key process for all major examinations. First, a provisional answer key is published shortly after the examination, giving candidates an opportunity to raise objections against any answer they believe is incorrect by paying the prescribed objection fee. Once all objections are received and reviewed by an expert committee, RPSC publishes the final answer key. The final answer key incorporates all validated corrections, if any.

Stage Purpose Can Candidates Object?
Provisional Answer Key Initial set of answers for review Yes, within the objection window
Final Answer Key Verified correct answers for result computation No - final and binding

The score calculated using the final answer key will be the official score considered for merit list preparation.

What Happens After the RPSC Final Answer Key Is Released?

Once the final answer key for the Analyst-cum-Programmer/Deputy Director exam is out, RPSC moves forward with the result and merit list preparation process. Candidates should be aware of the following next steps:

RPSC will evaluate all answer sheets using the final answer key. Based on this evaluation, the commission computes the marks scored by each candidate. A result preamble along with the cutoff marks for both the Main List and Reserve List will be published and notably, RPSC has already published the Result Preamble and Cutoff Marks (Main List) and (Reserve List) for the Analyst-cum-Programmer (Deputy Director) 2024 examination on 22 June 2026 on the official website.

Candidates who qualify the written examination will be called for the next stages of selection, which typically include document verification and/or a personality test (interview), as per the selection process defined by RPSC for this post.

Keep checking rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in regularly for updates on the merit list, final result, and further recruitment notifications.

Role Snapshot
Slingshot AI

Slingshot AI is the team behind Ash, the first AI designed for mental health. Our mission is to make support more accessible and help people change their lives in the ways they want.

Weâre building a world-class team by empowering individuals with the autonomy, flexibility, and support they need to do their best work. We dream big, iterate fast, and care deeply. If that sounds like you, weâd love to hear from you.

Our team spans machine learning, product, engineering, conversational design, clinical, growth, and operations, with offices in both New York City and London.

We're a well-funded Series A company, having raised $93M from Andreessen Horowitz, Radical Ventures, Forerunner Ventures, plus top-tier tech investors involved in ElevenLabs, Captions, Shopify, Plaid, Notion, Canva, Twitch, Airtable, and many others.

The Role

Weâre looking for someone to invent new ways for people to discover Ash. Ash is going from 0 to 1, and how we show up online will shape whether people trust us with something as personal as their mental health. We're looking for someone who lives at the intersection of content, social, and growth â a builder who can create things people want to share, and read the data to know what's actually working.

This is a hands-on role. One day you're writing and shipping a social campaign; the next you're spinning up a growth experiment, testing a new channel, or turning a product moment into content that travels. Youâve built things people care about. Maybe thatâs a social audience. Maybe itâs a community, a newsletter, a creative project, or a brand. Whatever it is, youâve learned what earns attention and trust.

A note on how we work: we love doing the work ourselves, so we can get good at it. You'll be hands-on across everything: making the content, running the experiment, pulling the numbers. A true jill (or jack) of all trades. You'll partner closely with our marketing team, our Head of Marketing, and our founders. You won't have a big team or a big playbook. We value moving quickly, learning fast, and out-of-the-box thinking. The right person comes up with an idea today and ships it today.

What You'll Do

  • Create content that travels. Make social-first content across channels that earns attention and connects to how Ash shows up in the world. You know what works on each platform and why.
  • Grow and test channels. Design fast experiments across social, organic, referral, and emerging channels. Use data to decide what deserves more investment.
  • Connect brand to growth. Translate Ash's positioning and messaging into content and campaigns that both feel right and drive results.
  • Turn moments into momentum. Take product launches and cultural moments and turn them into content and campaigns that build audience and demand.
  • Read the numbers. Live in the analytics enough to know which content, channels, and experiments are actually moving the needle, and act on it fast.
  • Build the audience. Grow Ash's presence across social from the ground up, with a feel for community, tone, and what makes people want to follow along.

What We're Looking For

  • 3 to 5 years across social, content, growth, or creator-led marketing, ideally at an early-stage startup where you did everything with limited resources
  • You have strong creative judgment. You know when something feels original versus derivative, and you make work people remember (the creators I like really had that capability)
  • You've grown an audience yourself; on your own channels or a brand's, and understand what makes content spread
  • Strong content and social instincts: you know what works on each platform and can make it yourself
  • Growth-minded: you design clean experiments, read the data honestly, and kill what isn't working
  • Brand-fluent: you understand positioning and messaging, and keep your work consistent with how Ash shows up in the world
  • Builder, not delegator: you've made the work yourself rather than managing agencies, and you prefer it that way
  • Scrappy and self-directed: you run with ambiguity and ship with incomplete information
  • Consumer experience strongly preferred (consumer app, CPG, or consumer health); creator or culture-native backgrounds welcome
  • Excited to build in mental health, with the judgment and care the category demands

Why This Role

You'll shape how a new kind of brand shows up in culture; grounded in how people actually feel, not just what they do or buy. You'll get the creative canvas of a true 0 to 1 and the data to know what's working, with the resources of a well-funded company behind you.

What We Offer

  • A chance to join a passionate tight-knit team working on something to change the world
  • Competitive compensation (top of personal market)
  • Travel between our NYC / London offices
  • Usual startup perks like free lunch and coffee in office + generous learning budget
  • We cover your personal therapy

Role Snapshot

Supply Chain Director

New York, USA

On-site / Hybrid depending on business needs


About the Company

Novaris Search is partnered with a growing business within the personal care and beauty manufacturing space that is looking to appoint a Supply Chain Director to lead and strengthen its end-to-end supply chain function.


This is a key leadership role for a commercially aware supply chain professional who can build structure, improve performance, and support the business through its next phase of growth.


Position Overview

The Supply Chain Director will be responsible for overseeing the full supply chain operation, including planning, procurement, inventory, logistics, and cross-functional coordination across the business.


The successful candidate will lead efforts to improve service levels, optimise inventory, strengthen supplier performance, and ensure the supply chain function is aligned with operational and commercial objectives.


This role would suit someone with strong leadership skills, a hands-on approach, and experience operating in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, ideally within personal care, cosmetics, beauty, or a related category.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end supply chain strategy across planning, procurement, inventory, warehousing, and logistics
  • Develop and improve supply chain processes to support service, cost, and efficiency targets
  • Partner with operations, manufacturing, commercial, and finance teams to align supply chain activities with business needs
  • Drive S&OP and demand planning processes to improve forecasting accuracy and supply continuity
  • Manage supplier performance and support procurement strategies to reduce risk and improve reliability
  • Oversee inventory strategy to balance working capital with customer service requirements
  • Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives across the supply chain function
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing supply chain team
  • Provide reporting, analysis, and leadership insight on supply chain performance, risks, and opportunities


Candidate Requirements

  • Proven experience in a senior supply chain leadership role within manufacturing
  • Strong background across planning, procurement, inventory, logistics, and supply chain strategy
  • Experience in personal care, beauty, cosmetics, OTC, or related consumer manufacturing would be preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams and improve supply chain performance in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong understanding of S&OP, forecasting, supplier management, and inventory optimisation
  • Commercially minded with the ability to work cross-functionally across operations and business leadership
  • Strong problem-solving skills, leadership capability, and communication skills


Why Join?

  • Opportunity to join a growing business in a key leadership role
  • High level of visibility and influence across the organisation
  • Chance to shape supply chain strategy and drive meaningful operational improvement
  • Work within a dynamic manufacturing environment supporting growth and transformation


Application Process

This search is being conducted on a confidential basis. If you would be interested in learning more, please apply directly or contact me for a confidential discussion at ben.symonds@novarissearch.com.

Pippin Title is a venture-backed real estate tech startup that offers nationwide, comprehensive, high-quality, technology-driven title search services to clients across the US. We're bringing title search into the 21st century.

How We Do It

We work with title insurance companies, property developers, and financial institutions to quickly and easily produce title documents to make the real estate closing process faster and more efficient.

Our proprietary cloud-based software allows our customers to manage their workflows efficiently, saving them time, money, and hassle. Having just closed a recent financing round, we are rapidly scaling our business - and our team!

What You Will Do

As a Residential Real Estate Title Search Quality Control, you will work with our search team to produce and review searches and title reports, determine the legal conditions of properties, and ensure the quality of the final product prior to delivery to our clients.

You are also be expected to support our Customer Service team on a regular basis by communicating with customers regarding important updates or clarifications, along with receiving and responding to order-related inquiries.

Role Snapshot

Role Description

The Vice President, Creative is the senior creative leader at Kanahoma, responsible for defining the agency's creative vision while leading a multidisciplinary organization of copywriters, designers, and videographers. Reporting directly to the CEO, this individual will oversee the agency's entire Creative Services product, balancing long-term innovation with exceptional day-to-day execution across every partner engagement.

This is a leadership role for someone who is equally energized by big ideas and operational excellence. You'll shape integrated brand campaigns, performance marketing creative, website experiences, commercial productions, and emerging creative capabilities while building and developing a high-performing creative organization. You'll partner directly with college and university presidents, CMOs, executive leadership teams, and boards while helping define where creative and the agency is headed next.


Role Responsibilities


Own Creative Services as a Product

  • Serve as the executive owner of Kanahoma's Creative Services product, defining its long-term vision, strategy, and continued evolution
  • Champion the intersection of creativity, brand strategy, performance marketing, AI, and emerging technology to ensure Kanahoma remains ahead of where the market is going
  • Develop new creative capabilities, services, frameworks, and best practices that strengthen the agency's competitive advantage
  • Partner closely with executive leadership on agency strategy, product development, and long-term growth
  • Collaborate with Sales on scopes of work and growth opportunities while supporting strategic partner presentations and new business development
  • Partner with account services and executive leadership on project scoping, budget estimation, and resource planning to ensure creative engagements are staffed appropriately and delivered profitably


Build & Lead a Best-in-Class Creative Organization

  • Lead and develop a multidisciplinary Creative organization of 10+ professionals across Copy, Design, and Video through a leadership structure of Associate Creative Directors
  • Recruit, mentor, and retain exceptional creative talent while fostering a culture of accountability, curiosity, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Develop leaders who can scale their respective disciplines while maintaining consistently exceptional creative quality
  • Build systems, workflows, and operational processes that allow creative excellence to scale without sacrificing speed or craftsmanship
  • Serve as the executive leader responsible for the overall performance, health, and continued development of the Creative organization


Lead Creative Strategy Across Every Channel

  • Provide executive creative leadership across integrated marketing campaigns spanning awareness through enrollment
  • Lead creative strategy across brand campaigns, paid social, paid search, websites, landing pages, digital experiences, video, photography, email, and organic content
  • Partner closely with Strategy, Paid Media, SEO, Web, and Account Services teams to deliver integrated marketing solutions that drive enrollment growth
  • Help partners uncover and communicate what makes their institution uniquely competitive in an increasingly crowded higher education landscape


Elevate Creative Performance

  • Apply a deep understanding of performance marketing to improve conversion across every stage of the enrollment funnel, from inquiry through enrollment
  • Ensure creative decisions are informed by strategy, audience insights, testing, and performance data, not simply subjective opinion
  • Continually evolve creative best practices based on campaign performance, market trends, and emerging consumer behavior


Lead Kanahoma Productions

  • Provide executive creative leadership for Kanahoma Productions, the agency's in-house production company
  • Lead six-figure productions with meaningful on-set creative direction and collaboration alongside producers, directors, production crews, photographers, and editors
  • Ensure every production reflects exceptional creative quality while supporting strategic marketing objectives and partner goals


Own Kanahoma Casting Deliverables

  • Play a consultative role in pitching new Casting projects
  • Develop bespoke Casting approaches for existing partner upsells
  • Lead all partner-facing Casting presentations
  • Work closely with the partner to determine audience pool
  • Develop email and survey content
  • With needed assistance from Agency Producer, coordinate interviews and follow-ups with respondents
  • Build out final casting book and, if a production is involved, consult with the wider team on best-fit cast members


Shape the Future of Creative

  • Maintain a strong point of view on emerging trends across AI, organic content, digital platforms, search behavior, creative technology, and the future of marketing
  • Explore and implement thoughtful applications of AI that elevate creative thinking, improve workflows, and strengthen outcomes without replacing creativity
  • Encourage experimentation, learning, and innovation throughout the Creative organization


Serve as a Strategic Agency Leader

  • Represent Kanahoma's Creative organization with confidence and credibility in executive presentations, partner meetings, pitches, and strategic consulting engagements
  • Present creative strategy to CMOs, university presidents, executive leadership teams, and boards of trustees
  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to partners, helping connect institutional objectives with creative solutions that drive measurable growth


Role Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive creative leadership experience, including meaningful time within an agency environment
  • Demonstrated success leading multidisciplinary creative organizations spanning copy, design, video, web, and digital experiences
  • Proven experience managing and developing creative leaders while building high-performing teams and strong creative cultures
  • Significant experience concepting and leading integrated marketing campaigns that successfully combine brand storytelling with measurable performance marketing
  • Deep understanding of paid media creative, paid search, paid social, websites, landing pages, conversion optimization, and full-funnel customer journeys
  • Meaningful experience developing creative strategies that support complex, multi-step consideration cycles rather than simple awareness campaigns
  • Demonstrated experience leading website redesigns, digital experience initiatives, and cross-channel creative strategy
  • Significant experience leading six-figure commercial productions, including meaningful on-set creative leadership
  • Confidence presenting creative strategy and campaign recommendations to executive leadership, clients, university presidents, and boards
  • A passion for emerging technology, AI, and the future of marketing, with demonstrated experience leveraging AI to elevate creative thinking, workflows, and outcomes, not replace them
  • Meaningful higher education marketing experience is strongly preferred; experience in other highly competitive industries is equally valuable, and candidates who bring both perspectives are especially encouraged to apply
  • A creative portfolio demonstrating candidate experience is required


Kanahoma's Mission

Our mission is to build a better agency for organizations building a better world. Whether we're building a brand or driving the bottom line, we pride ourselves on being progressive performance marketers called to serve and support mission-driven organizations across the education and nonprofit industries.

By joining Kanahoma, you are committing to core values that define our (and your) success, and shape how we approach everything we do, every day:


We Find A Better Way

At Kanahoma, we are relentless in our pursuit of building a better agency. So when a solution isn't satisfactory we make our own.


Results Aren't Our Goal, They're Our Engine

At Kanahoma, winning is a prerequisite. We are constantly pushing to evolve and iterate our work to exceed expectations and ensure our partners get the results they deserve.


Just A-Players

We play and win as a team. We don't believe that confident, superior work should come at the expense of company culture.


We Seek to Serve

We embrace our role as a service business and seek opportunities to go above and beyond for our partners.


We execute on the above core values by balancing the four pillars of advocacy:


Self Advocacy: Asserting and clearly communicating your needs and interests while taking responsibility for personal well-being and decisions


Team Advocacy: Championing your team's needs, addressing their challenges and highlighting their achievements to ensure they have the resources and recognition to succeed


Business Advocacy: Supporting and promoting Kanahoma's goals, securing and/or requesting the necessary resources to make strategic decisions to drive growth and exceed goals


Partner Advocacy: Representing the partner's needs, goals, and best interests by ensuring their concerns are heard, providing solutions that align with their objectives, and delivering value to build trust and satisfaction

Role Snapshot
Canopie is a digital maternal health company supporting pregnant and postpartum individuals through structured, evidence-based support, education, and care navigation. We meet members where they are offering fully virtual access to coaching, classes, and clinical resources across the perinatal journey.

We are building a more inclusive and responsive model of care; one that recognizes the value of lived experience alongside clinical expertise.

Why This Role Matters

Decisions that shape the pregnancy and postpartum experience are deeply personal. Individuals navigating this time benefit from support that reflects real, lived understanding, not just clinical guidance.

Maternal Health Peer Specialists play a critical role in the care continuum by offering empathetic, experience-informed support. This role helps ensure members feel seen, understood, and empowered to make decisions that align with their own values, needs, and circumstances.

Peer support is not about directing decisionsâit's about creating space, sharing perspective when appropriate, and helping members navigate what feels right for them.

What You'll Do

  • Provide virtual peer support to members across pregnancy and postpartum, grounded in lived experience
  • Offer empathetic listening, validation, and encouragement through key perinatal transitions
  • Share personal insights when appropriate to normalize experiences and reduce isolation
  • Conduct outreach and engagement using structured workflows and communication tools
  • Support members in navigating common challenges (emotional wellbeing, identity shifts, recovery, feeding, sleep, returning to work)
  • Encourage connection to Canopie services (coaching, classes, clinical care) based on member needs
  • Recognize when additional or clinical support may be needed and follow defined escalation pathways
  • Document interactions clearly and consistently within Canopie's platform
  • Communicate with members via phone, video, and secure messaging
  • Participate in training, supervision, and peer support development

Scope & Boundaries

  • This is a non-clinical role and does not provide medical or mental health treatment
  • Peer Specialists do not diagnose or direct care decisions
  • The focus is on support, connection, and helping members navigate available resources
  • Clear escalation pathways are in place for clinical or higher-risk needs

Requirements

Who Thrives in This Role

Required

  • Lived experience with pregnancy and/or the postpartum period within the last :3-5 years
  • Ability to thoughtfully reflect on and use personal experience to support others in a balanced, appropriate way
  • Some experience in maternal health, peer support, community-based work, or caregiving roles
  • Comfortable providing virtual support and building connection in a digital environment
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a warm, non-judgmental approach
  • Ability to follow structured workflows while maintaining authenticity in interactions
  • Strong digital literacy (video platforms, messaging tools, documentation systems)
  • Reliable, organized, and responsive in a remote setting

Preferred

  • Experience in peer support roles (formal or informal)
  • Exposure to perinatal mental health, coaching, or support groups
  • Background working with diverse or underserved populations
  • Bilingual (Spanish/English)

Schedule & Commitment

  • Part-time contractor role (approximately 20 hours/week; varies by program needs)
  • Availability during business hours required; evening and weekend availability is a plus

Benefits

  • Fully remote, digital-first care model
  • Ongoing clinical training, peer consultation, and supervision
  • Opportunity to help build equitable access to maternal health support at scale

Role Snapshot
About the role
 This position exists to ensure the digital interfaces used in our client mandates are as clear and rigorous as our strategic analysis. We are currently supporting a major organization based in Birmingham, and this role will help build the tools used to visualize their corporate governance structures. You will translate the logic of our senior partners into functional, professional user interfaces.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for significant family groups and government entities. We operate as a fully remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead.

What you will do
  • Develop responsive and clean user interface components using modern web technologies.
  • Collaborate with firm principals to understand the data requirements for our Birmingham based client projects.
  • Maintain a consistent visual language across all digital reports and internal analytical tools.
  • Build and refine dashboards that help clients achieve portfolio clarity and understand complex data sets.
  • Write clean, documented code that adheres to our internal standards for simplicity and reliability.
  • Debug front end issues and ensure that our tools perform reliably across different browsers and devices.
  • Help transform static operating model diagrams into interactive digital components.
  • Participate in internal reviews to ensure that our software tools align with the professional tone of the firm.


What we are looking for
  • Foundational knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • A basic understanding of modern front end libraries, such as React or Vue, gained through studies or personal projects.
  • The ability to explain technical concepts clearly and concisely in writing.
  • A logical mindset that prioritizes functional clarity over unnecessary visual complexity.
  • Attention to detail in layout, typography, and the way information is structured on a screen.
  • A willingness to learn about corporate governance and holding company structures.


How we work
 We operate as a global remote firm, which means our effectiveness relies on written precision and individual accountability. Without the distractions of a physical office, we focus our energy on solving complex problems for our clients. Mentorship happens through direct interaction on active mandates, where junior team members work closely with principals to understand how to form a view and defend it. We value honesty and directness. If a solution is not working or a design is too complicated, we address it immediately. This environment requires a high level of self discipline and a genuine interest in the intersection of engineering and corporate strategy.

What the role offers
  • A permanent, full time position within a principal led strategy firm.
  • The flexibility of a fully remote work arrangement.
  • Direct exposure to high level corporate strategy and governance projects.
  • Competitive pay that is attractive for an entry level position in today's market.
  • A professional environment where your work has a visible impact on client outcomes.
  • Clear mentorship and a path to grow your technical skills within a specialized sector.

  • Maintain and update the influencer marketing calendar and campaign timelines

  • Manage reporting dashboards, creator deliverables, and budget trackers

  • Active user of TikTok and Instagram with a sharp eye for trends and emerging creators
  • Extremely organized with strong attention to detail - you don't let things fall through the cracks
  • Comfortable managing data and performance metrics in spreadsheets
  • Strong communicator with excellent time management skills
  • Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, scrappy environment
